claims.statement: Tom Allen's friends gave him a complimentary benefit at the Avenue Theater in Washington on June 10, 1876.
claims.excerpt: selected by Tom Allen’s friends to tender him a complimentary benefit

claims.statement: Tom Allen was to appear in an exhibition of his boxing skill with his trainer, Jack Madden, at the benefit.
claims.excerpt: will have the pleasure of appearing before the audience in an exhibition of his skill in the manly art

notes: Announcement printed the day of the benefit; no result is given.
